intent_summary: A lagged-response relationship compares current response with a supplied or training-fitted multiple of an earlier predictor.

criteria.criterion: A supplied lag and coefficient use the predictor at the declared earlier sample position.
Derived values retain response and predictor source indexes and source cutoffs in lineage.
When requested, the coefficient is fitted once from a declared training prefix and remains frozen.
Samples lacking the earlier predictor or awaiting coefficient training remain unavailable.

verification_evidence: Primary Codex agent inspected every declared implementation reference and compared acceptance criteria with current source and test assertions; this is a fresh semantic review, completed in the existing session.
Inspected lagged-response leading unavailable values and first usable sample: supplied coefficient 2, lag 2, response index 2/predictor index 0 and source cutoff preserved.
